metadata.description: Wire format for `vibe registry sync --json` — what was refreshed, what was skipped, and why. Source of truth for `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/registry_sync_report.rs`.
Required member: a sync that refreshed nothing writes `[]`, never an absent key — omitting a required collection would produce a document invalid by this same schema (rule R21).
Required member: a sync that skipped nothing writes `[]`, never an absent key — omitting a required collection would produce a document invalid by this same schema (rule R21).
Git ref the clone was refreshed against — typically `v<version>` or a branch name for overrides.
